skill_friction: Step 5 field-choice fork: Total_Storefronts__c matches the requirement's words but NumberofLocations__c is the user-visible field (on layouts, LWC, editable by 46 profiles) and has identical values; the skill's 'decide when wording answers it' vs 'ask when evidence points both ways' leaves this borderline. I decided without asking.

Mechanism rule 'standard, then flow, then code' has no explicit guidance on whether undelete coverage alone justifies Apex over two record-triggered flows; I chose Apex and recorded it as documented platform behavior.

Account merge (reparented children fire no triggers) is a correctness gap for any Lookup roll-up; design-rules says 'cover records that start or stop matching' but does not say whether a second trigger on a shared object (Account) is in scope. Kept as a non-blocking proposal.

The 'two wrong AskCoworker claims' threshold was crossed during R/T (SetNull semantics, merge trigger firing, FLS defaults, DML limits); rule says verify every kept fact, but untestable platform claims can only fall back to documented behavior, which is still tagged 'assumption' — no distinct tag for 'documented behavior contradicting AskCoworker'.
R split rule: SKILL says a split sends both halves and counts as one retry, but run.json kinds have no 'split' marker; I logged both halves as kind 'retry'.
RUNNER says scratch files under {out}/.tmp/ while org-verification.md says design/.tmp/; followed the eval note.
